plot-title: The span density along the long reasoning traces
plot-caption: The counted spans per 1,000 characters in each tenth of the reasoning traces of 4,000 characters or more. Dashed with hollow markers: the F4 prompt; solid with filled markers: the F9 prompt. A density that falls to 0 near the end would say that the extractor stops reading; in the last tenth the density is 47% to 72% of its peak.
